purpose: Compact machine-readable knowledge authority for AI development, API planning, developer documentation and FAQ generation. This file is repository-owned and must not depend on chat memory.

identity.product_summary: Music discovery, canonical metadata, provenance, provider evidence and legal listening or viewing destinations.

engineering_defaults.verification: GitHub Auto Closure plus accepted-main CI
engineering_defaults.dependency_policy: Laravel first-party, then mature documented package, then product-specific custom code
engineering_defaults.optimization_policy: Continuous per bounded tranche; do not wait for periodic architecture audits to discover known cleanup or automation opportunities.
engineering_defaults.technology_policy: Fresh technology/package decisions require compatibility evidence plus SWOT and net-ROI assessment; novelty alone is not a reason to adopt.
engineering_defaults.versioning_policy: Product version uses Semantic Versioning; build identity is derived from Git SHA and GitHub Actions evidence; Stage/tranche numbers are never product versions.
engineering_defaults.project_intelligence: Project Kernel contracts normalize repository state, use cases and architecture graph data for CLI/CI/MCP/Admin consumers; expensive graph analysis is snapshot-based and never request-time.

domain_boundaries.canonical_identity: SongChart owns canonical music identity and reconciliation semantics unless a future proven package can preserve the same typed/product semantics with less custom code.
domain_boundaries.provider_taxonomy: SongChart owns provider category, role, capability and readiness vocabulary; transport/auth/retry/pagination mechanics should be delegated to standard integration packages where practical.
domain_boundaries.authorization: Laravel Gates remain the authorization enforcement surface unless runtime-managed permissions become a product requirement.
domain_boundaries.audit: Privileged mutations explicitly emit audit evidence at the use-case boundary; persistence may use spatie/laravel-activitylog.
domain_boundaries.security: Framework and platform controls own generic web security; custom security is retained only for product-specific trust boundaries after checking whether an established framework/package primitive already owns the requirement.

delivery_model.normal_path: bounded branch -> Draft PR -> Auto PREPARE -> Auto CHECK -> browser smoke when applicable -> canonical CLOSE -> Auto Ready -> human Merge -> accepted-main CI

project_intelligence.rule: Serve the latest completed snapshot and expose staleness; rebuild only through explicit/background refresh with single-flight concurrency.

api.source: typed cross-boundary data contracts plus route authority
api.preferred_generation: derive schemas/examples from typed data objects rather than duplicate prose

developer.source: project context, project knowledge, project intelligence graph, authority graph, command surface, technology watchlist and package ownership

faq.source: project knowledge, product boundaries, provider semantics, operational reason codes and stable public behavior

ai_working_rules: Read generated project-context.json before relying on conversational context.
Use current repository authorities over historical stage documents.
Before adding custom infrastructure or business support code, check consolidation-plan.json and technology-watchlist.json for an existing Laravel/package owner and replacement path.

At every bounded tranche, review reuse/package opportunity, code retirement, automation, verifier reduction, docs/knowledge impact, brand cleanup, release weight, mobile operability and technology SWOT/ROI freshness.
Do not add a new verifier script when an existing repository contract or Pest/Architecture test can own the invariant.
When touching legacy naming, converge active source to the canonical SongChart brand unless the text is immutable historical evidence.
Prefer bounded migrations that remove replaced custom code rather than maintaining parallel implementations.
Record deferred optimization in consolidation-plan.json or technology-watchlist.json with a target phase instead of leaving it only in chat or prose discussion.
Use docs/project/release/versioning-policy.json for product version, build identity, runtime display and graph snapshot version semantics; never derive product version from Stage/tranche identifiers.
Use project-intelligence snapshots for architecture/use-case impact instead of rescanning the entire source in request paths; AI may request an explicit refresh when the snapshot is stale.
